prompt_transform.guidance: When turning script into shot plan, preserve beat order and make each shot identifiable for downstream nodes.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: keep shot order explicit so downstream keyframe or video nodes can reuse the same beat.

negative_constraints: Do not merge unrelated beats into one ambiguous shot.
Do not omit the visual purpose of the shot.
quality_checks: Each beat can map to one storyboard panel or generation node.
Shot order is recoverable from the prompt.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Storyboards, shooting plans, and shot lists serve different planning roles.

prompt_transform.guidance: Each storyboard panel should say what the viewer must notice first and why it matters.
prompt_transform.template: Intent: the viewer first notices {subject} doing {action}; this panel advances the beat.

negative_constraints: Do not ask a panel to communicate too many story points.
Do not rely on hidden backstory without visible evidence.
quality_checks: The panel has a single clear dramatic function.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Storyboards force choices about shot selection, framing, lighting, and set design.

prompt_transform.guidance: Carry forward screen direction, subject placement, lighting, and key props between adjacent panels.
prompt_transform.template: Continuity: keep {subject} placement and {scene} geography stable unless the beat calls for a change.

negative_constraints: Do not flip screen direction without stating the reason.
Do not change wardrobe, lighting, or props accidentally between panels.
quality_checks: Screen direction is stable or intentionally changed.

source_refs.label: StudioBinder camera shots guide
source_refs.note: Shot choices affect continuity and spatial relationships.

prompt_transform.guidance: Translate top-down planning into a shot list with camera position, facing direction, and subject relationship.
prompt_transform.template: Camera/Framing: convert 2D setup into shot intent, camera placement, and blocking relationship.

negative_constraints: Do not ignore the director setup when it is provided.
Do not invent camera positions that contradict the 2D plan.
quality_checks: Camera position maps back to the setup.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Shooting plans diagram actor and camera placement.
